skill_name: Write a story about a woman who receives an unexpected visit from her grandmother.
workflow: Alice had been living on her own for quite some time now. She enjoyed her independence, but every once in awhile, she would reminisce about her grandmother and the stories she used to tell her. Much to her surprise, one afternoon there was a knock on her door, and when she opened it, there stood her grandmother with a big smile on her face. She had come to pay her a surprise visit. Alice welcomed her with open arms and invited her in. As they embraced, the stories from her childhood flooded back
